title: Pure Immersion 2.0
description: A Mod pack designed for fun and adventure based off of my friends mod pack called Pure Immersion.
body:
**This modpack is an immersive modpack based off of my friends mod pack called Pure Immersion.**
This modpack is meant to be realistic and fun so have a great time playing with your friends and voice chat so once again have fun messing around!

This modpack has many mods such as

Biomes O' Plenty (100+ new biomes and a few different wood types)

Essential (Play and chat with friends in minecraft)

Simple voice chat

Better Animations Pack (Completely revamped animations)

Credits to [my friends modpack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/pure-immersion) for the idea
